name: spatz-mod
description: Recommends Claude models and effort with spatz and can apply them to subagents and the main session.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: off, show (recommend only) or apply (rewrite model and effort)

scope.title: Routing scope
scope.description: When spatz decides: step, turn, subagent, session or escalate

main.title: Apply to the main session
main.description: In apply mode, also rewrite the main session. A model switch drops the prompt cache.

record.title: Record usage
record.description: auto (off while the spatz plugin is enabled), on or off

minPromptChars.title: Shortest prompt that gets a new decision
minPromptChars.description: turn and escalate keep the last decision for shorter prompts

escalateAfter.title: Failures before escalating
escalateAfter.description: escalate moves to the next stronger pair after this many failing test or build results

spatz.title: spatz executable
spatz.description: Executable to run; the default uses this plugin's launcher

models.title: Models
models.description: Claude model candidates, strongest model first
